result.summary: Several visual bugs stand out: a nonsensical -0% discount badge, a truncated restaurant name in the horizontal list, and a cut-off category chip that looks unfinished.

issues.description: The lower food card shows a discount badge labeled "-0%", which is meaningless and looks like broken or missing promotional data.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0, or only render it when a real positive discount percentage is available.

issues.description: The third "Fastest near you" card title reads "Trattoria Piccol" and is visibly cut off at the edge without a proper ellipsis or full-name treatment.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card titles truncate with an ellipsis within the card bounds, and/or add peek/fade styling so partial carousel cards don’t clip mid-word awkwardly.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with a partially visible empty pill on the right, which looks like a clipping or layout glitch rather than a clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade edge or consistent peek of the next chip, and ensure chips aren’t rendered as empty/broken fragments off-screen.

issues.description: Horizontal restaurant cards in "Fastest near you" are clipped mid-card at the screen edge with no gradient mask, making the section feel abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Apply a right-edge fade or padding so the carousel truncation feels intentional and polished.
